scope: Static full IL/metadata/script AST only; no management lifecycle, auth, HTTP or Go execution. Cloud-specific TRPS handoff independently traced; shared runtime code included as primary bodies, not inferred from another command.

trace.evidence: Root custom/CmdletConfig.json maps each Remoting ordinary command to corresponding Modern function, AutoRestModuleName Microsoft.Teams.ConfigAPI.Cmdlets; no DefaultAutoRestParameters member. CmdletConfig constructor initializes absent/null default map to empty.

CmdletConfiguration.InitializeCmdletInfo constructs TrpsCmdletAutoRestCommandInfo(rootModule,config). Constructor resolves config.AutoRestModuleName/config.ModernCmdlet via module-bound PowershellUtils.GetCommandInfo, stores returned CommandInfo unchanged. Default flight selection passes descriptor.Command; runtime mocks/overrides are explicit alternate branches.

BeginProcessing consumes/removes MsftInternalProcessingMode. GetParameters copies bound inputs, incorporates default map entries unchanged; no insertion of InvocationInformation. Ordinary Cloud signature has no such parameter. Property-bag handling cannot create an own-invocation override on these no-business-parameter Modern functions.
SyncProcessor.ReceiveOutput AddCommand(selected CommandInfo) then AddParameters(dictionary), then AddTrpsExecutionId; no helper instance access, reflection assignment or renaming.

CustomRunspacePool.Create imports pinned custom module/private dll/export proxies into new runspaces. Wait callback AddCommand(commandInfo.Name) then AddParameters(dictionary), AddTrpsExecutionId. No helper-instance/InvocationInfo injection. Scope excludes name shadowing and configured command mocks.

AddTrpsExecutionId conditionally adds only HttpPipelinePrepend carrying ExecutionIdContainer.SendAsyncSteps, priority TRPS. That step signals execution ID then forwards the same request/callback. Default SetExecutionId handler updates telemetry state only.

Explicit Modern Get/New proxies resolve exact private *_Get/*_New CmdletInfo and invoke through steppable pipeline. ProcessCustomAttributesAtRuntime reads breaking-change/preview attributes and emits warnings; its underscore-split is warning formatting only, not command metadata rewriting.

Both exact selected Cloud helper InvocationInformation properties have zero parameter attributes, public setter unused by private assembly direct calls, getter caches own MyInvocation. ProcessRecordAsync passes getter to Module.CreatePipeline; no outer TRPS InvocationInfo is supplied.

Shared Module pipeline captures that own InvocationInfo; PSInvocationInfo.GetCommandName returns MyCommand.Name unchanged; final SendAsyncCallback.AddUseragentAndCmdletNameHeaders inserts X-MS-CmdletName. Header writer and default ExecutionId/event/terminal/clone code included verbatim.

negative_override_proof.parameter_attributes: Both InvocationInformation properties have no Parameter or other attributes; not binding surfaces.

whole_private_inline_method_scan.scope: Every InlineMethod operand in all declared method/constructor bodies of pinned private assembly; direct calls only, dynamic reflection inspected separately on selected handoff paths

negative_override_proof.reflection: Inspected resolution/Sync/async/parameter-transfer/proxy/message-attribute handoff paths contain no SetValue/SetField or helper-instance access to inject InvocationInformation. Message helper reflection is attribute reads, not setters.
negative_override_proof.dynamic_scope_limit: Caller-installed event listeners, pipeline hooks, SessionConfiguration mocks/CmdletConfigOverride or runtime command shadowing can substitute behavior and are excluded from default pinned path.

remaining_gap: Public TRPS selects Modern only through runtime flighting/override/availability; this static trace does not assert ordinary invocation always selects Modern, nor capture a live management request. Within default selected-Modern scope no unresolved handoff/header gap remains.
